Crisp fried rolls filled with pork, cabbage, carrot and soy, straight out of a food truck window.
the Oregon coast where Stephanie lives

Toasted hazelnuts set in a thin amber caramel with butter and a pinch of bicarb for crunch, snapped into shards and finished with flaky salt. Toast 200g hazelnuts at 180C for 10 minutes, rub off the skins and roughly chop. Line a tray with baking paper. Cook 250g caster sugar, 80ml water and 2 tbsp golden syrup in a heavy pan without stirring until deep amber, about 10 minutes. Stir in 30g butter, half a tsp bicarb soda and the nuts. Pour onto the tray, spread thin, sprinkle with flaky salt and cool 30 minutes before snapping.
M: Stephanie's truck, fried onions on everything
Two thin patties smashed on a hot griddle with onions pressed into the meat, American cheese, pickles and mustard on a toasted bun.
the lab canteen before the escape

Franks griddled until blistered in steamed buns, smothered with beef chilli, melted cheddar and diced onion, with a stripe of mustard. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Griddle 8 franks for 6 minutes until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns. Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli and grated cheddar, then grill 1 minute to melt. Top with diced onion and mustard.
W: Blackberries tossed with sugar and lemon under a buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 35 minutes, vanilla ice cream.
K: Fresh lemon juice and raspberries muddled with sugar syrup, topped with soda water over crushed ice and finished with mint and lemon wheels. Muddle 150g raspberries with 80ml sugar syrup in a jug until pulpy. Stir in 120ml fresh lemon juice. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice and divide the raspberry mix between them. Top each with 150ml cold soda water and stir gently. Garnish with a lemon wheel and a mint sprig.

s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels, then add 150g kernels once they pop, cover and shake until popping slows. Toss half with 40g melted butter and salt, and half with 40g grated parmesan and cracked pepper. Keep it coming.

Fry 300g pork mince with 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1 grated carrot, 2 sliced spring onions and 2 tbsp soy sauce until dry. Roll a spoonful in each of 12 spring roll wrappers, sealing with water, and fry in 5cm hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes until golden.

m.note: Stephanie's truck, fried onions on everything
m.how: Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Put a few thin onion slices on each, then smash flat onion-side down on a hot griddle. Flip after 90 seconds, add American cheese and stack two per toasted bun with pickles and mustard.

w.how: Toss 600g frozen blackberries with 80g sugar, 1 tbsp cornflour and the juice of 1 lemon in a baking dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour with 50g sugar, stir in 120ml milk and dot over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes and serve with vanilla ice cream.
